name: TARDIS
description: A Views style plugin that renders a reverse-chronological list of year and month links to content.
project_description:
TARDIS is a module that allows users to go back in time and visit nodes from the past. You can see nodes per year and month, using a View display that creates links automatically, filtered in the format YYYY/MM . 

 Back to top 

 Roadmap 
 
 Ability to use any Date field, apart from Created date . 
 Custom pager based on months and years. 
 Filter results weekly and bi-weekly . 
 
 Note: sonic screwdriver not included.
